set.body: Observed 2026-10-10 00:08: the landing gate's tests step failed with 'could not open /private/tmp/eyes4s-jdk25/jdk-25.0.4.1+1/Contents/Home/lib/jvm.cfg' while forking ioJVM tests; bin/java still exists but lib/jvm.cfg is gone (the JDK was unpacked 2026-08-18 under /private/tmp, which macOS periodic cleanup prunes of files not accessed for days). The wrapper /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-gate-bin/sbt used by every agent's gates points at this JDK, so library and Studio gates on JDK 25 are broken until it is reinstalled. Only Temurin 21 is registered with java_home. Fix: install Temurin 25 at a durable location (e.g. ~/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines) and point the wrapper (or a repo-documented env var) there; document the location in AGENTS.md's build section. Studio projects need JDK 22+.
set.title: Shared JDK 25 under /private/tmp is being purged by macOS tmp cleanup; local gates break mid-run
